episode_summary: In this episode, Vija Williams discusses the evolving role of real estate agents in the post-AI age, emphasizing the importance of engaging with sellers early through cash offer leads. She highlights the shift in consumer behavior and the need for agents to offer multiple exit strategies to remain competitive. The episode provides actionable insights for team leaders and aspiring top producers looking to adapt to these changes.
